title: Admin selection controls announce their current state

source.ref: Frequency full audit conditional-state consumer review

detail: Page status, CRM task filters and header preview sorting now expose selected state through aria-pressed and named groups. The public-practice bulk switch exposes role=switch and aria-checked with a stable name, retaining its opposite-state action and pending gates. Four actual jsdom interaction tests cover selection/content ordering and both switch directions; all four fail against actual pre-repair components and pass after repair. Action boundaries are mocked; no production mutation or browser/assistive-technology acceptance claim.

verify.note: Checks actual control state bindings; paired rendered interaction tests run in normal CI.
